ticket.subject: MORE GRANULAR ROLES
ticket.body_text:
Hi team,

Writing on behalf of Kettlewick Ltd. Please add custom roles with permissions we can choose ourselves.

Our contractors currently see more than they need. Other apps we use let us copy a role and change a few settings.

Please consider it for a future release.

Regards,
Freya Marchetti
